name: responsive-table
title: Responsive table
description: A table that turns into stacked label and value cards when its own box is narrow, with the table semantics kept for screen readers.
docs: Below 40rem of its own width each row is a card; the switch is a container query, so a sidebar, a dialog and a page behave alike. header must be plain text, because it is also the label in front of a value in a card. priority 2 and 3 columns leave the table as the box narrows (below 48rem and 60rem) and always show in a card. primary names the column that becomes the title and the row header; getRowHref turns it into a link, or the whole card in the card layout. Give it a box with a width: a flex item needs w-full or min-w-0.
